item.title: Glide bombs: How these cheap weapons are giving Russia its battlefield edge back in Ukraine
item.summary: The Ukraine conflict showcases new combat innovations, especially Russian glide bombs. These weapons allow strikes from safe distances, protecting aircraft from enemy defenses. Russia uses conversion kits and purpose-built munitions to leverage vast bomb stockpiles effectively. India is also developing its own glide bombs for deep strike capabilities. These advancements aim to hit targets with reduced risk to aircrew.
